text: Sometimes reality becomes so harsh - your identity becomes so harsh - that it needs more than treatment, more than a bandage. It needs a complete transformation. A complete metamorphosis. They will tell you a man cannot come back from where I went. They are right. A man cannot. I am what came back instead.
